hero.skeleton.name: Skeleton Spearman
hero.wizard.name: Pumpkin Wizard
hero.bat.name: Bat-cat Assassin
hero.knight.name: Heavy Pumpkin Guard
hero.skeleton.blurb: Javelin: 24 damage. A hit applies Frost Curse (the target's next 2 attacks deal −15%) and bleeding.
hero.wizard.blurb: Pumpkin Cannon: 36 damage, high arc, big punch, poisons on a hit. Low HP: a glass cannon.
hero.bat.blurb: Shuriken: 1 per throw, 29 damage, slows on a hit; the ultimate throws 5 in a small spread.
hero.knight.blurb: Bouncing Shield: a die decides 1 to 6 collisions and the 21 total damage is split evenly; each collision may drain 5% of its damage as health. Most HP of all; can also place a Floating Shield.
hero.bride.name: Ghost Bride
hero.bride.blurb: Sound wave: 40 damage in the first 35 px cell around the centre, 75% in the second cell, 50% in the third; it hits every enemy unit in range, on both sides of the centre. Poisons on a hit.
hero.hunchback.name: Bell Tower Hunchback
hero.hag.name: Silver Cross Sister
hero.hag.blurb: Silver cross: a hovering sister hurls a spinning silver cross wrapped in black smoke, 24 damage, 25% chance to shock on a hit (the target's next turn is 4 s shorter); the ultimate stuns with electricity.
hero.hunchback.blurb: Giant axe: heavy and spinning, 19 damage, makes the target bleed and knocks it back.
hero.reaper.name: Necromancer
hero.reaper.blurb: Purple Ghost Flame: pushes a ball of fire out of the palm, 22 damage, burns on a hit (−2 for the next 3 rounds). The three ghost flames behind him are his Energy.
